description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait' which provides properties and accessor methods for date range filtering, specifically 'fromDate' and 'toDate'. It is used within the OrangeHRM leave plugin in the DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace to encapsulate date range filter parameters.

classes.name: DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait
classes.description: A trait providing date range filtering properties and methods for use in data transfer objects, specifically for 'fromDate' and 'toDate'.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the range.
